nodes.name: Every Hour
nodes.notes: Chews through unqualified leads in the background. Safe to run any hour.

nodes.name: W3 Config
nodes.notes: The only node you edit. Must match Workflow 1 on base and table.

nodes.name: Plan Fit Columns
nodes.notes: Creates Fit / Fit Reason / Fit Checked At if missing. Touches nothing else.

nodes.name: Loop Schema Changes
nodes.notes: Output 0 = done (fires once), output 1 = one pending change.

nodes.name: Fit Columns Ready
nodes.notes: Runs once. Aborts if a column could not be created.

nodes.name: Fetch Unqualified Leads
nodes.notes: Only leads not yet judged AND not yet contacted.

nodes.name: Build Qualification Queue
nodes.notes: Resolves a URL per lead (Website column, else email domain). Drops free mailboxes and same-domain duplicates.

nodes.name: Loop Over Leads
nodes.notes: One lead at a time. Output 0 = done, output 1 = loop.

nodes.name: Readable?
nodes.notes: Leads with no resolvable site skip straight to a stored "Unsure".

nodes.name: Fetch Website
nodes.notes: A timeout, 404 or blocked scraper arrives as data, not a crash.

nodes.name: Read Page
nodes.notes: HTML -> text, capped at PAGE_CHAR_LIMIT. Too thin to judge -> Unsure.

nodes.name: Ask Claude
nodes.notes: Header credential: x-api-key. Classifies the page only — it never writes email copy.

nodes.name: Parse Verdict
nodes.notes: Any failure resolves to Unsure, never No. An outage must not delete leads.

nodes.name: Save Fit to Airtable
nodes.notes: Writes Fit / Fit Reason / Fit Checked At. Nothing else is touched.

parameters.content:
## Workflow 3 — Lead Qualifier  *(optional)*

Reads each lead's website and writes a **Fit** verdict to Airtable. It decides **who** you email — it never writes a word of **what** you email.

**Why not AI-personalized copy?** A generated opener ("I came across your portfolio of transitional kitchen remodels...") is the most recognizable pattern in cold email — it reads as *more* of a pitch, not less. And anything a model writes into a live send is untestable. Targeting is where the leverage is at 30 sends/day: not emailing a roofer beats any phrasing.

**Fail-open, everywhere.** A dead site, a timeout, an API outage → `Unsure`, which is still contacted. Only an explicit `No` is skipped. Never running this workflow at all leaves Workflow 1 behaving exactly as before.

### Where the URL comes from
1. a `Website` column, if you have one
2. otherwise the email domain — `dana@mapleridgekitchens.com` → `mapleridgekitchens.com`

Free mailboxes (gmail, yahoo, …) tell us nothing, so those leads are recorded as `Unsure` and contacted normally.

### Cost
`claude-sonnet-5` at low effort, ~1.5k input tokens per page:

**≈ $4 per 1,000 leads.**

Cheaper than the verification credits saved on leads that were never a fit.
